Research

I connect genome-wide computation, wet lab validation and field breeding, across crops.

Gene families and evolution

Genome-wide identification and comparative genomics across plant lineages.

Fiber and stress biology

Fiber development and abiotic stress tolerance in crop plants.

Molecular breeding

Breeding approaches and GWAS for plant genetic improvement.

Field phenotyping

RCBD trials, DUS characterization and multivariate analysis of cotton lines.

Under review in JPGR

My BSc thesis work on the Kinesin-7 gene family, co-authored with Zhengzhou University and the National Cotton Breeding Institute, is now a manuscript under review. My MSc thesis, supervised by Dr. Abdul Rahman, characterizes ten stable cotton breeding lines under semi-arid conditions.

Tools I build

Each one began as a problem in my own work. Both are live.

Cotton DUS Trait Collection App

Field data collection built around the FSCRD DUS qualitative descriptors and the morpho-physiological traits from my MSc trial.

  • Enter data once, in the field
  • Exports clean datasets ready for ANOVA, MCA and diversity analysis
  • Mobile app, plus a desktop version online
Open the desktop version

Faisal Academy

A live learning platform for agriculture students, developed with Claude Code.

  • Revision modules and free student registration
  • Admin dashboard tracking student activity
  • Firebase Authentication and Firestore, hosted on Netlify
